verdicts.evidence: The three-scale functional ANOVA audit uses exact enumeration on a 5^3=125 product grid with reconstruction error 8.88e-16, directly showing additive log-hazard has zero higher-order effects while the same model produces non-zero hazard pair effects (0.005–0.011 RMS) and time-dependent survival-scale higher-order effects; the 2-feature scenario tests confirm exact TD/TI partitioning with 15-order-of-magnitude margins across 12 seeds.

On scenarios A–C (within Theorem 3.2's scope: independent features, linear/additive G), SurvFD exactly recovers ground-truth TD/TI partitions in 3/3 cases, stable across 12 seeds with TI effects at floating-point zero (~1e-15) versus the genuine TD effect spread of 0.748.

Using the paper's Appendix A.2 example, downward propagation to {x1} is confirmed (spread 2.818, 10/10 seeds) while upward propagation to {x1,x2,x3} is absent (spread 1.28e-15, 10/10 seeds), and the paper's closed-form f1(t|x)=x1^2+t*x1-1 matches numerical estimates within MC error.

The ten Fig. 2 scenarios are transcribed and local accuracy is computed at machine precision (~1e-16) for ground-truth functions, but the specific <0.015 threshold applies to fitted CoxPH/GBSA models, which were explicitly not attempted due to missing scikit-survival; only the algebraic-identity case on ground truth is tested.
The TCGA-BRCA multi-modal application is not addressed anywhere in the logbook; no experiments with real patient data or cross-modality interaction analysis were run.

Four synthetic coalition games at 10–16 features show regression RMSE lower than permutation in all 8 budget cells (ratios 0.10–0.31), matching the paper's direction, but the games are synthetic proxies—not the paper's four datasets—and only two of the paper's full method panel are compared.

overall: The logbook provides strong, exact-computation verification of the paper's theoretical claims (Theorem 3.2 exact recovery, Theorem 3.3 asymmetric propagation, and three-scale additivity-failure characterization) with seed-robustness sweeps. Empirical claims involving real data (TCGA-BRCA) and fitted models (Figure 2's <0.015 threshold, Figure 7's full method comparison) are either unaddressed or tested only via synthetic proxies.
